title: Welcome to the warehouse team
passage: F1: Welcome to your first shift at Westfield Distribution. Before we go onto the warehouse floor, please put your personal belongings in the lockers behind you. Your locker number is printed on the back of your identification card. Today you'll work with an experienced colleague rather than operate equipment alone. The first task is checking returned goods against the accompanying forms. Do not send damaged products directly back to the shelves, even when the customer has marked the package as unopened. Put them in the inspection area with a yellow tag. At eleven, we'll meet in the training room for a demonstration of the inventory scanners. If you finish the returns early, ask your colleague to show you the emergency exits.
passageZh: 歡迎各位在 Westfield Distribution 開始第一個班次。進入倉庫作業區前，請把私人物品放在身後的置物櫃，櫃號印在識別證背面。今天要和資深同事一起做，不要獨自操作設備。第一項工作是比對退貨及隨附表格。損壞商品即使客戶標示未拆封，也不可直接放回貨架，要貼黃標籤放入檢驗區。十一點在訓練室示範庫存掃描器。如果提早完成退貨工作，請同事帶你認識緊急出口。
